report:
Reviewed the complete current claim, ordinary implementation association in crates/sage-meta/src/review.rs, and all three associated ordinary tests after a fresh start. Captured Fixture, CLAIM, TEST and persisted-input helpers through review read of tests/review.rs lines 1–107. No TODO/N/A entries exist.
Requirements are source-line arrays for claim, implementation and complete annotated-test snapshots in input.json, with exact newline reconstruction including internal blanks, whitespace and markup. InputFragment.contents is Vec<String> and derives serde serialization. inventory calls source_lines for claim content, implementation files and test-function slices; implementation excerpts use it too. source_lines splits on newline without dropping empty interior or trailing segments, trimming whitespace, interpreting markup, or losing carriage returns. start writes the resulting input.json through write_json; capture_read uses the same representation. record preserves captured input. This implements all representation requirements.
initial_context_preserves_instructions_and_exact_uniform_fragments compares the complete returned input with Fixture::input(), which deserializes persisted input.json, and visibly joins each snapshot class to its expected source. The fixtures exercise Rust indentation, comments, attributes and a trailing implementation newline. complete_claim_blocks_are_selected_but_unrelated_movement_is_not_stale explicitly joins a claim containing blank lines, bold markup, paragraphs, list, table and fenced code to the exact expected body; its successful record and unchanged-content gate assertion additionally exercise persistence, and later changes in each content section become stale. whole_files_and_ranges_preserve_exact_line_endings_and_detect_selected_edits reads mixed CRLF/LF content containing an internal blank line, verifies range results, loads persisted input and joins its whole-file fragments to the exact original text. It also detects adding the final newline. Together these assert the shared conversion behavior and the three initial snapshot paths without needing duplicated tests for each cross-product. Dropping blank lines, normalizing line endings, damaging markup, stripping indentation or changing trailing-newline preservation would violate these assertions.
The initial test-adequacy concern is resolved by associating the two existing claim/whole-file tests with this anchor, with coordinator authorization, rather than duplicating their assertions. Fresh current inputs contain the complete three-test set. No production code changed. Executed cargo fmt plus review start/read commands; report recording follows. Existing suites/build were reported by the coordinator, not executed by this reviewer; no behavioral test execution is claimed here. Final build/test and mandatory independently delegated post-codegen and Sage sanity checks remain the coordinating agent’s validation responsibility for the annotation changes. Source assessment finds implementation complete and test coverage adequate, with no requested edits.
